name: color-swatch-picker
title: Color swatch picker
description: Preset colors as named swatches, optionally ending with a button that opens a color picker for a custom color.

when: Choosing from a small set of preset colors.

instead.when: Any color is allowed and presets are a shortcut at most.

builtIn: Each swatch is named; the caption names the selection.
youProvide: A label and a name for each preset.

genui.description: Named preset colors to choose from. Emits change with the hex.
